overview: At home you listed the second shirt and the grey cloak as what goes. You wrote that the chronicle stays, and that the pages of the wood stay. You did not count those pages, and you did not take the chronicle down.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the list and did not count the pages.

assets.name: Holinshed's second volume
assets.disposition: Listed the second shirt and grey cloak to go, chronicle and pages of the wood to stay
